# Vantage Point Recovery

> A residential mental health and addiction treatment center in California offering evidence-based programs including residential detox, PHP, IOP, and specialized trauma care with therapies like EMDR, brainspotting, and cognitive behavioral therapy.

Vantage Point Recovery is a comprehensive mental health treatment facility located in Thousand Oaks, California, serving the Los Angeles area. The center specializes in residential and outpatient programs for anxiety disorders, bipolar disorder, PTSD, complex trauma, and substance abuse, emphasizing personalized, holistic treatment approaches.

## Key Topics

- Vantage Point Recovery
- Residential Mental Health Treatment
- PTSD and Complex Trauma
- Bipolar Disorder
- Anxiety Disorders
- EMDR Therapy
- Brainspotting
- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP)
- Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP)
- Residential Detoxification
- Somatic Therapy
- Mindfulness-Based Practices
- Case Management
- LGBTQIA-Affirming Care

## Core Treatment Programs

- [Residential Mental Health Treatment Center in California](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/mental-health-treatment): Inpatient residential mental health treatment with CBT, psychodynamic therapy, and individualized support.
- [Partial Hospitalization Program (PHP) at Vantage Point Recovery](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/php): Partial Hospitalization Program details including brainspotting, EMDR, and trauma-informed therapy.
- [Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP Treatment) in Los Angeles by VP](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/intensive-outpatient-program): Intensive Outpatient Program for substance abuse and mental illness with yoga and mindfulness.
- [Vantage Point Residential Detox Treatment Program](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/vp-residential-detox): Residential detoxification program for substance abuse with medical detox and withdrawal management.

## Specialized Treatment Services

- [Best Complex Trauma Residential Treatment Programs](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/complex-trauma-treatment): Specialized complex trauma and PTSD residential treatment programs with LGBTQIA-affirming care.
- [Bipolar Disorder Treatment Center | Vantage Point Recovery](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/bipolar-disorder-treatment): Bipolar disorder treatment center offering medication management and psychotherapy for all types.
- [Social Anxiety Disorder Treatment at Vantage Point Recovery](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/social-anxiety-disorder-treatment): Treatment services for social anxiety disorder with customized therapeutic care plans.
- [Panic Attack Disorder Treatment at Vantage Point](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/panic-disorder-treatment): Panic disorder and panic attack treatment with clinical information and effective interventions.
- [Case Coaching Program at Vantage Point Recovery](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/case-coaching-case-management): Case coaching and management program for mental health recovery and community resources.

- [Our Culture, Vision, Mission, Values & Method | Vantage Point](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/who-we-are): About page detailing company mission, vision, values, and evidence-based treatment philosophy.
- [Treatment Model at Vantage Point Recovery](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/our-model): Explanation of Vantage Point's personalized holistic treatment model and therapeutic approach.
- [Core Competencies of Vantage Point Recovery Treatment](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/our-core-competencies): Overview of core competencies including self-awareness, emotional intelligence, and personal empowerment.
- [Progressive Abstinence to Understand Coping Mechanism | Vantage](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/progressive-abstinence): Guide to progressive abstinence and replacing maladaptive coping mechanisms with adaptive ones.
- [Commitment of Vantage Point Recovery Treatment Center](https://vantagepointrecovery.com/our-commitment): Statement of ethical commitment to program integrity, patient quality of life, and community philanthropy.
